name: application-ballot-option-list
title: Ballot Option List
description: Formal pre-vote ballot: a radiogroup of candidate/measure rows, each with an optional expandable More info panel, and no result percentages since voting hasn't happened yet.
useWhen: Rendering an electoral ballot or measure vote where the user selects exactly one option before submitting.
You need per-candidate biographical detail available on demand without cluttering the default row.
Distinct from Poll Vote Card, which shows result percentage bars (before or after voting) rather than a formal single-select ballot with per-candidate biographical detail.
avoidWhen: You want to show live or final vote percentages — use Poll Vote Card instead.
The choice allows multiple selections — a checkbox-based list is more appropriate than a radiogroup ballot.
responsiveBehavior: Candidate name and the More info toggle stay on one row via flex; the expanded info panel wraps normally beneath, indented to align under the name rather than the radio input.
accessibility: Options are grouped in a real <fieldset role="radiogroup"> with an aria-label naming the race, giving native single-choice keyboard behavior.
The selected option's row uses a distinct border, not just a filled radio, keeping the current pick visible even at a glance.
The info toggle button uses aria-expanded and aria-controls, and its label switches between "More info" and "Hide info" for a plain-text state cue.

variants.title: Ballot Option List
variants.description: Three City Council candidates in a radiogroup, one selected, with an expanded More info panel showing a short bio.
accessibility: Radiogroup fieldset carries an aria-label naming the race for screen reader context.

variants.title: Ballot Option List (Dark)
variants.description: The same ballot adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Selected-row border and radio contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
